# Code of Conduct — Purpose

## Purpose
This Code of Conduct sets the standard of professional behavior expected of all NimbusCloud Inc. employees, contractors, and partners.

# Code of Conduct — Respectful Workplace

## Respectful Workplace
Harassment, discrimination, or retaliation of any kind based on race, gender, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic will not be tolerated and will result in disciplinary action up to and including termination.

# Code of Conduct — Conflicts of Interest

## Conflicts of Interest
Employees must disclose any financial or personal interest that could conflict with company decisions, including relationships with vendors, competitors, or direct reports. Disclosures are submitted to the Ethics Committee via the Conflict of Interest Form.

# Code of Conduct — Confidentiality

## Confidentiality
Employees are required to protect confidential company information, including unreleased product plans, financial results, and customer data, both during and after their employment with NimbusCloud Inc.

# Code of Conduct — Reporting Violations

## Reporting Violations
Violations of this Code of Conduct may be reported anonymously through the Ethics Hotline at ethics@nimbuscloud.example. Retaliation against anyone reporting a violation in good faith is strictly prohibited.

# Code of Conduct — Enforcement

## Enforcement
Confirmed violations of this Code of Conduct are reviewed by HR and Legal, and disciplinary outcomes range from a formal written warning to immediate termination depending on severity.

# Expense Reimbursement Policy — Purpose

## Purpose
This document outlines the process and limits for reimbursable business expenses at NimbusCloud Inc.

# Expense Reimbursement Policy — Submission Process

## Submission Process
All expense reports must be submitted through the Expensify platform within 30 days of the expense being incurred. Reports submitted after 60 days will not be reimbursed except in exceptional circumstances approved by Finance.

# Expense Reimbursement Policy — Reimbursable Categories

## Reimbursable Categories
- Client meals: up to $75 per person
- Domestic travel: economy class airfare, standard hotel rates up to $250/night
- International travel: requires pre-approval from department VP
- Software/tools: up to $200/month without additional approval; above this requires manager sign-off

# Expense Reimbursement Policy — Non-Reimbursable Items

## Non-Reimbursable Items
Personal entertainment, alcohol at non-client events, and traffic/parking violations are not reimbursable under any circumstances.

# Expense Reimbursement Policy — Approval Chain

## Approval Chain
Expenses under $500 require single manager approval. Expenses between $500 and $5,000 require both manager and Finance approval. Expenses above $5,000 require VP-level sign-off.

# Expense Reimbursement Policy — Corporate Card Usage

## Corporate Card Usage
Employees issued a corporate card must reconcile all transactions monthly. Failure to reconcile for two consecutive months may result in card suspension.

# Information Security Policy — Purpose

## Purpose
This policy establishes minimum security requirements for all NimbusCloud Inc. employees and contractors accessing company systems.

# Information Security Policy — Password Requirements

## Password Requirements
All passwords must be a minimum of 14 characters, include at least one number and one special character, and must be rotated every 180 days. Password reuse across the last 10 passwords is prohibited.

# Information Security Policy — Multi-Factor Authentication

## Multi-Factor Authentication
MFA is mandatory for all access to production systems, the internal VPN, and the company's cloud infrastructure console. Employees who disable MFA without IT Security approval are subject to immediate access revocation.

# Information Security Policy — Data Classification

## Data Classification
Data is classified into three tiers: Public, Internal, and Restricted. Restricted data (including customer PII and payment information) may only be stored in approved, encrypted storage systems and may never be transferred via personal email or unencrypted USB drives.

# Information Security Policy — Incident Reporting

## Incident Reporting
Any suspected security incident, including phishing attempts, lost devices, or unauthorized access, must be reported to security@nimbuscloud.example within 1 hour of discovery via the #security-incidents Slack channel or the Security Hotline.

# Information Security Policy — Third-Party Access

## Third-Party Access
Vendors and contractors requiring system access must undergo a security review and sign a Data Processing Agreement before provisioning begins. Access is granted on a least-privilege basis and reviewed quarterly.

# Remote Work Policy — Purpose

## Purpose
This policy defines eligibility, expectations, and equipment provisions for employees working remotely at NimbusCloud Inc.

# Remote Work Policy — Eligibility

## Eligibility
Employees who have completed their 90-day probationary period are eligible to apply for remote work arrangements. Eligibility is reviewed by the employee's manager and HR business partner.

# Remote Work Policy — Work Hours and Availability

## Work Hours and Availability
Remote employees must be available during core collaboration hours of 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM in their assigned time zone. Outside of core hours, employees may adjust their schedule with manager approval.

# Remote Work Policy — Equipment Provision

## Equipment Provision
The company provides a laptop, a docking station, and a one-time $500 home office stipend for eligible remote employees. Requests for additional equipment must be submitted through the IT Asset Request Portal.

# Remote Work Policy — Security Requirements

## Security Requirements
Remote employees must use company-issued VPN software when accessing internal systems and must not use public, unsecured Wi-Fi networks for work involving customer data.

# Remote Work Policy — Review Cycle

## Review Cycle
Remote work arrangements are reviewed annually during the employee's performance review cycle. Management reserves the right to modify or revoke remote work privileges based on performance or business needs.

# Vacation and Leave Policy — Paid Time Off (PTO) Accrual

## Paid Time Off (PTO) Accrual
Full-time employees accrue 1.25 days of PTO per month, totaling 15 days per year. PTO accrual increases to 20 days annually after 3 years of continuous employment, and 25 days after 6 years.

# Vacation and Leave Policy — Carryover Rules

## Carryover Rules
Employees may carry over a maximum of 5 unused PTO days into the following calendar year. Any PTO balance beyond this cap is forfeited on December 31st unless local law requires otherwise.

# Vacation and Leave Policy — Sick Leave

## Sick Leave
Sick leave is accrued separately from PTO at a rate of 1 day per month, up to 12 days annually. Sick leave does not carry over and resets each calendar year.

# Vacation and Leave Policy — Parental Leave

## Parental Leave
NimbusCloud Inc. provides 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for the secondary caregiver, applicable to birth, adoption, or foster placement.

# Vacation and Leave Policy — Requesting Time Off

## Requesting Time Off
PTO requests must be submitted at least 2 weeks in advance through the HR portal for approval, except in cases of emergency. Manager approval is required for all PTO requests exceeding 5 consecutive days.
